Chlorine dioxide (ClO2) is a broad-spectrum disinfectant that targets bacteria, viruses, and biofilm with high efficiency. Because it oxidizes contaminants instead of simply masking them, it works differently from chlorine. Instead of forming potentially harmful by-products like trihalomethanes (THMs), chlorine dioxide breaks down without lingering chemical residues.

When you mix the powder with water following the kit instructions, it reacts to form chlorine dioxide gas in a controlled way. Then, this gas dissolves in the water and acts to:

  • Oxidize organic matter responsible for odours
  • Improve overall water clarity and taste

What Is Siliphos Polyphosphate Media?

Siliphos polyphosphate media is a food-grade, granular additive designed to protect plumbing systems from corrosion and rust. When water flows over the media, it releases polyphosphates that form a thin, invisible protective layer inside pipes and tanks. This coating prevents iron, steel, and other metal surfaces from oxidizing, reducing rust, and extending the life of water systems.

Unlike traditional water softeners, Siliphos polyphosphate media does not remove hardness minerals or existing scale. Instead, it prevents new rust formation while allowing minerals like calcium and magnesium to remain in solution.

Key Features

  • Protects metal surfaces: Forms a thin, protective layer inside pipes, boilers, and tanks.
  • No chemicals or salt required: Safe for drinking water systems.
  • Low maintenance: Simply place the beads in a housing and replace them every few months.
  • Food-grade material: Suitable for potable water systems.
  • Compatible with hot and cold water: Effective up to ~80�C.

  • Recommended concentration: ~2-3 ppm in water
